# cartesian_to_spherical

Nguồn: [manim.utils.space_ops.cartesian_to_spherical](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.utils.space_ops.html#manim.utils.space_ops.cartesian_to_spherical)

cartesian\_to\_spherical(*vec*)
:   Returns an array of numbers corresponding to each
    spherical coordinate value `(r, theta, phi)`.

    Parameters:
    :   **vec** ([*Vector3DLike*](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.typing.html#manim.typing.Vector3DLike "manim.typing.Vector3DLike")) – A numpy array or a sequence of floats `[x, y, z]`.

    Returns:
    :   An array `[r, theta, phi]` where:

        - `r` is the distance (radius) from the origin,
        - `theta` is the azimuthal angle (angle in the xy-plane
          from the positive x-axis),
        - `phi` is the polar angle (angle from the positive z-axis).

    Return type:
    :   np.ndarray
